title: Gap Cluster 02 DRILL: Cell and Nuclear Division
subtitle: H2 Biology 9477 · Book 3 · 8 questions · 55 marks · 18 parts · one mark per minute, so about an hour · every question lifted from a real paper
los_html:
What this gap drill covers, gap by gap. The mend doc closes them; these questions test them.
B3-15 chromosome number against DNA content through meiosisQ1(a), Q1(b), Q1(c), Q1(d), Q2 statement 3, Q8(a), Q8(b)
B3-16 the tallest peak is the longest phaseQ2 statement 1
B3-17 mitotic anaphase separates sister chromatidsQ3, last row
B3-18 a centriole is nine triplets of microtubulesQ4(a)
B3-19 independent assortment is meiosis-onlyQ3, independent assortment row; Q7 metaphase I significance
B3-20 telomere shortening is examinable, telomerase is notQ5(a), Q5(b), Q5(c)
decay-prone: the three-level packing ladderQ4(b)
decay-prone: telophase in full, and polar microtubules slidingQ6(a) other valid point, Q6(b)
decay-prone: the mitosis-against-meiosis comparisonQ3

Duplicate check on the answers, not the labels. Only Q3 requires the mitosis-against-meiosis contrast pairs. Only Q7 requires the significance of meiotic chromosome behaviour, where the marks are for random distribution and 2ⁿ rather than for the phrase independent assortment. Only Q4(b) requires the packing ladder, only Q4(a) the centriole, only Q5 the end replication problem. Q1 runs the two counters in three different currencies, graph traces, histogram peaks and telomere counting, so no two parts of it share a marking point. Two overlaps are real and deliberate. The anaphase pair, centromere divides and sister chromatids separate, sits in Q3 as one half of a contrast and in Q6(a) as one of four spindle roles, but Q6(a) is marked out of 3 and full marks are reachable on its other three points, so treat the polar microtubule point as the one Q6(a) is actually testing. Independent assortment appears in Q3 as a contrast pair and in Q7 as a significance claim; the required sentences are different and neither scores the other.
